Market today:
The mood is cautious for tech/chip names. Rising Treasury yields nearing 5% and Fed rate hike expectations are the real drivers, making growth stocks less appealing. Adding to this, AI industry leaders are openly discussing slowing down, which could cool investor enthusiasm for your core holdings.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-52.13%) and SPAL (-30.89%) are in deep drawdowns with "SELL" status; their leveraged nature means these drops hurt extra on margin. QQQI (-3.28%) is also flagged for "TRIM" attention.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on the Fed's upcoming rates decision and how the market reacts to the AI industry's calls for a slowdown. These are key for your tech-heavy book.

Bottom line:
Prioritize risk management on your leveraged, underperforming positions in this cautious market.
plays: SOXL: With a -52.13% loss and "SELL" status, consider reducing exposure. Your default stop at 200 is far; adjust it much tighter to manage risk.
SPAL: Also a "SELL" at -30.89% and leveraged. Review your stop at 21.38 and consider trimming some to protect capital.
QQQI: Flagged for "TRIM" at -3.28%. Consider taking some off the table to reduce exposure, especially with rising rates.
